key_terms: An Atlas type definition that declares the attributes and relationships its instances can carry, often inheriting from DataSet or Process.
One instance of an entity type representing an asset or process, stored with a server-assigned GUID.
The globally unique identifier Atlas assigns to a stored entity instance.
The unique attribute a producer sets so that retries can locate the same logical asset without knowing its GUID.
A typed definition of how two entity types connect, such as a process to its input and output datasets.
evidence: Complete real Atlas REST payload/client route with default local server omitted. Native compatible server preparation and actual API/graph/index/lifecycle acceptance are explicit separate work, never simulated execution.
